sourceTileEdgeNote: The AWS mirror readme states that shared southern/eastern edge samples are removed from public COGs. This N31/E035 tile has a 3600x3600 grid; the requested bbox is well inside its available sample centers.
verification: Reopened crop and source; every crop float32 sample equals the exact integer source window; verified dimensions, CRS, dtype, nodata, AREA_OR_POINT=Point and affine transform. Independent Pillow decoder reproduced the same pixel comparison.
modifications: Integer pixel-aligned crop and lossless DEFLATE re-encoding only. No resampling, reprojection, value edits, filling, smoothing, warping or terrain derivation.
productClassification: Modern 30 m digital surface model (DSM), including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation; research reference only. Not bare-earth terrain, ancient surface, archaeological footprint, historical site placement or game/map authorization.
verticalReference: EGM2008 (EPSG:3855), metres, according to Copernicus GLO-30 product documentation; the downloaded TIFF does not expose a vertical-datum tag, so this is documentation attribution only.
horizontalReference: WGS84-G1150 / EPSG:4326, per Copernicus GLO-30 product documentation; the TIFF CRS tag reports EPSG:4326.

preview.stretch: 2nd–98th percentile linear display stretch; source raster values unchanged
preview.caption: Modern DSM surface, including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation. Not ancient terrain, bare earth, or a playable map.

reproduction: Source URL and SHA-256 above; derive pixel offsets from pixel-center coordinates and requested bbox, then read/write that exact Rasterio window. Temporary Python environment; no project runtime dependency added.
etagNote: Recorded as the S3 object ETag, not treated as a cryptographic checksum; sourceSha256 is the integrity digest.
